zh.title: Frontier Airlines重返奧克蘭 填補西南航空縮減運能空缺
zh.summary: Frontier Airlines重返奧克蘭；填補西南航空縮減20%運能缺口
body: 超低成本航空公司 Frontier Airlines 正式重返奧克蘭，填補西南航空在該地區調整營運後留下的航線與市場運能空缺。西南航空先前在奧克蘭進行了約百分之二十的服務縮減，為其他超低成本航企提供了擴充市場網絡的機會。
隨著西南航空縮減在奧克蘭的營運規模，Frontier Airlines 藉由重新進入該機場，積極接管相關市場需求。此項航線佈局調整反映出超低成本航空公司在主要業者縮減運能之際，爭取市場份額與拓展服務據點的最新營運動態。

en.title: Frontier Airlines Returns to Oakland Following Southwest Pullback
en.summary: Frontier Airlines returns to Oakland; carrier fills service gap after Southwest cuts capacity by 20%.
body: Ultra-low-cost carrier Frontier Airlines is returning to Oakland, stepping in to fill market capacity left vacant following an operational scale-back by Southwest Airlines. Southwest Airlines previously reduced its overall presence at the airport by 20%, creating an opening for rival low-cost carriers seeking network expansion opportunities.

Following Southwest Airlines' decision to pull back flight capacity in Oakland, Frontier Airlines is positioning itself to capture local passenger demand and absorb remaining route traffic. The transition highlights operational moves by ultra-low-cost carriers to acquire market share as major domestic airlines adjust their local operational footprint.

zh.title: 西南航空宣布首座機場貴賓室網絡；捷藍、易捷跟進
zh.summary: 西南航空宣布首批四座機場貴賓室；捷藍、易捷陸續布局；Chase夥同協助開發
body: 低成本航空公司陣營中，貴賓室服務漸成趨勢。西南航空宣布推出其首個機場貴賓室網絡，初步選定於奧斯汀-伯格斯特國際機場、巴爾的摩/華盛頓瑟古德·馬歇爾國際機場、檀香山丹尼爾·井上國際機場及納什維爾國際機場四處開設。
據報導，相關工程已動工，首批貴賓室最快於2027年底啟用，西南航空並表示未來數年會陸續增設至少七間。此方案是與金融業者Chase合作，西南航空尚未披露新聯名信用卡的相關資訊。
西南航空並非首例：捷藍航空已分別於紐約甘迺迪機場及波士頓洛根機場推出BlueHouse貴賓室；易捷航空則於倫敦蓋特威克機場與No1 Lounges合作，自2021年起營運貴賓室。

en.title: Southwest joins low-cost rivals in rolling out airport lounge network
en.summary: Southwest to open first lounges; JetBlue and easyJet among low-cost carriers expanding premium airport services
body: Southwest Airlines has announced its first airport lounge network, with initial locations at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS), Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI), Daniel K. Inouye International Airport in Honolulu (HNL) and Nashville International Airport (BNA).

Construction has already begun, with the first lounges expected to open from late 2027, and the carrier said at least seven additional locations will follow over the next several years. The lounges are being developed in partnership with Chase, tied to a new premium Southwest Rapid Rewards credit card scheduled to launch in 2027.

Southwest joins a growing group of low-cost airlines offering premium airport services. JetBlue opened its first BlueHouse lounge in December 2025 and a second in August 2026, while easyJet has operated The Gateway at London Gatwick in its own North Terminal in partnership with No1 Lounges.
